subject: Security incident notification — telemetry export & IRP access for SIG review
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@finpartner.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>; jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: compliance@finpartner.com
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 17:12:00 -0700
Subject: Telemetry anomaly — request for IRP and telemetry export for SIG review

Hi Vanessa / Jonas,

Quick heads-up: our security team detected an unusual spike in token-generation requests attributed to one of your hosted endpoints in our tenant between 2027-05-29 03:00 UTC and 2027-05-29 03:45 UTC. This looks like an automated retry loop from a subset of IPs. At this stage it appears limited but we need to complete our SIG review and internal audit.

Can you please: 
- Share your Incident Response Plan (IRP) snapshot relevant to customer-facing telemetry and log retention (redacted is fine)
- Provide a telemetry export (aggregated request logs, timestamps, source IP ranges, request IDs) covering the window above in CSV or JSONL
- Confirm who on your side will be the point-of-contact for evidence transfer and a short call to walk through the artifacts (30 min)

We'd like to complete an initial triage today/tomorrow and then follow with a formal SIG questionnaire review. I can accept documents via the secure Drive folder (we can also accept DocuSign for retainer if needed).

For context: FinPartner is undertaking a quarterly vendor SIG and wants time-boxed evidence for this event. No formal escalation yet, but compliance requested an artifacts bundle.

Attachments: none in this message (we’ll give the format we prefer in a follow-up).

Thanks,
Alicia Gomez
Head of Security Operations
FinPartner
Alicia.gomez@finpartner.com
+1 415-555-0186
From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@finpartner.com>
Cc: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 18:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Telemetry anomaly — request for IRP and telemetry export for SIG review

Hi Alicia — thanks for the flag and the clear scope. We’ll prioritize this.

Quick plan: 
1) I’m attaching a redacted IRP snapshot that covers our telemetry retention, log access controls, and evidence-handling workflow (IRP_snapshot_redacted.pdf). It omits customer-identifying fields.
2) We can produce the telemetry export as CSV (example filename: telemetry_export_20270530.csv). We’ll include: request_id, timestamp_utc, model_id, route, source_ip (CIDR-masked for privacy), account_id (hashed), and response_code.
3) Marissa (Security Ops) will lead the artifacts pull; Karthik (Security Eng) will join the call for technical context. Jonas will be on the thread for contract/comms.

Proposed times for a 30-min evidence walk-through (PT):
- Mon 2027-05-31 09:00–09:30 PT
- Mon 2027-05-31 11:00–11:30 PT
- Mon 2027-05-31 16:00–16:30 PT

Please confirm which works. We’ll upload the CSV to the Drive link and add a checksum. For any sig/questionnaire specifics, if you can drop priority items we’ll accelerate those answers first.

Attachments: IRP_snapshot_redacted.pdf (redacted), note: telemetry export will follow within 2 business hours of time confirmation.

—
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Director, Customer Security & Trust
Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@finpartner.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: compliance@finpartner.com; LegalOps <legalops@finpartner.com>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Telemetry anomaly — request for IRP and telemetry export for SIG review

Vanessa — thanks, that works. 11:00–11:30 PT is ideal for our SOC/compliance reviewer and their engineer.

A couple quick asks ahead of the call to help us triage faster: 
- Can you include the first-line correlation IDs (redwood_request_id) if available — our SIEM can join on that to map events
- Please mask CIDR ranges as you indicated but keep a consistent mask per source_ip so we can still see distinct origin groups
- We’ll upload three priority SIG questions to the Drive folder; please pre-review SIG_priority_questions.xlsx so we can walk the answers during the call

We’re also sending a DocuSign retainer for evidence access (standard). You may see an envelope from DocuSign — LegalOps will countersign.

Attachment: SIG_priority_questions.xlsx (uploaded to Drive).

See you at 11:00 PT.

Best,
Alicia
From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@finpartner.com>, compliance@finpartner.com
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 19:05:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: FinPartner SIG — evidence handoff plan and owners (post-call actions)

Team — recap after the 11:00 PT call with FinPartner: brief anomalous retry loop, no evidence of exfiltration, customer seeking artifacts for SIG review. Action items: 

- Marissa: produce telemetry_export_20270530.csv to the secure Drive link. Include fields: redwood_request_id, timestamp_utc, model_id, route, source_ip (CIDR-masked but consistent), response_code. Target upload: Tue 2027-06-01 08:00 PT.
- Karthik: confirm whether any internal throttling or retry policy changes were triggered during the window and provide a short tech note (max 2 pages).
- Jonas: coordinate with LegalOps to complete the DocuSign retainer if it appears; provide customer-facing comms draft if they want a short statement.
- Me (Vanessa): perform an IRP redaction check and prepare a 1-page post-call summary for FinPartner. I will not include PII or any customer-identifying data.

We also agreed to deliver prioritized answers to the three SIG questions Alicia uploaded — I’m attaching the question list to this thread for clarity (SIG_priority_questions.xlsx). Keep responses concise. Once artifacts are shared we’ll mark the thread for SOC2 evidence tracking.

Please do not share raw PII in the Drive upload; redact or hash account ids. Reach out if you need more than the target windows.

Thanks — Vanessa
